name: en_to_italian_words
description: Few-shot English->Italian single-word translation. Control: same format, English->English copy.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
D=[("dog","cane"),("cat","gatto"),("house","casa"),("water","acqua"),("bread","pane"),("book","libro"),("tree","albero"),("sun","sole"),("moon","luna"),("city","città"),("car","macchina"),("friend","amico"),("night","notte"),("day","giorno"),("red","rosso"),("green","verde"),("black","nero"),("white","bianco"),("big","grande"),("small","piccolo"),("new","nuovo"),("old","vecchio"),("woman","donna"),("man","uomo"),("child","bambino"),("king","re"),("time","tempo"),("world","mondo"),("school","scuola"),("door","porta"),("window","finestra"),("table","tavolo"),("chair","sedia"),("milk","latte"),("apple","mela"),("fish","pesce"),("bird","uccello"),("horse","cavallo"),("sea","mare"),("mountain","montagna"),("river","fiume"),("fire","fuoco"),("hand","mano"),("head","testa"),("heart","cuore"),("eye","occhio"),("money","soldi"),("work","lavoro"),("love","amore"),("street","strada"),("week","settimana"),("year","anno"),("morning","mattina"),("summer","estate"),("winter","inverno"),("cheese","formaggio"),("wine","vino"),("church","chiesa"),("garden","giardino"),("kitchen","cucina"),("flower","fiore"),("rain","pioggia"),("snow","neve"),("wind","vento"),("egg","uovo"),("key","chiave"),("blue","blu"),("good","buono"),("beautiful","bello"),("happy","felice")]
items=[];control=[]
for t in D:
    shots=random.sample([d for d in D if d is not t],3)
    items.append({"prompt":"".join(f"English: {s[0]}\nItalian: {s[1]}\n\n" for s in shots)+f"English: {t[0]}\nItalian:","answer":" "+t[1]})
    control.append({"prompt":"".join(f"English: {s[0]}\nEnglish: {s[0]}\n\n" for s in shots)+f"English: {t[0]}\nEnglish:","answer":" "+t[0]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open("/work/skill.json","w"),ensure_ascii=False)
